decisions.reason: The schlager compilation had its own product page for two years, reflecting visible commitment that creates justification pressure to persist despite modest investment.
As an illustrated series with several models, it represents substantial investment and public commitment central to the firm's curated direction, making persistence highly likely.
The jazz vinyl reissue builds directly on the firm's core reissue expertise and had a dedicated page, so dropping it would write off a central, visibly committed product.
The multi-disc box set required significant production investment and is close to the established offer, so escalation pressure favors keeping it.
It was only mentioned on the website without its own page, indicating little investment and minimal public commitment, so management has little to justify and will drop it.
